summary: Restored the missing helper functions in jwt/utils.py (base64url, uint, PEM/SSH detection and DER/raw signature conversion) that blocked collection of every test module, and added the missing PyJWK/PyJWKSet constructors and properties (from_dict, from_json, key_type, key_id, public_key_use) in jwt/api_jwk.py. The last full-suite result I saw was 240 passed and 19 failed, with all 19 failures in tests/test_jwks_client.py, which another fixer claimed.
